newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to cut customs surcharge to 3 pct May 15.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to cut customs surcharge to 3 pct May 15.

text.p: The Hungarian government decided on Sunday to reduce the surcharge on imported goods to three percent from the current four percent on May 15, a government spokesman said on Sunday.

"From May 15 the customs surcharge will be reduced further by one percentage point, to three percent," Elemer Kiss, Secretary of State of the Prime Minister's Office told a news conference following the government's meeting.
Hungary first introduced an eight percent import surcharge in March 1995 as part of its austerity programme which succeeded in reining in the country's soaring current account and trade deficits.
Last year the government said it would honour its international obligations to phase out the tax completely by July 1 1997.
